name: What is the difference between orange-peel and knockdown texture?
description: Orange-peel leaves rounded, uniform spray droplets across the wall. Knockdown uses larger splatter droplets that are smoothed flat with a trowel before drying.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between orange-peel and knockdown texture?

acceptedAnswer.text: Orange-peel texture provides a dimpled, slightly bumpy surface reminiscent of citrus skin, created by spraying thinned joint compound under high air pressure. Knockdown texture starts with a similar spray application, but the raised droplets are allowed to set partially and then flattened with a wide trowel. Matching requires identifying this difference immediately, as applying a standard orange-peel spray to a knockdown surface creates a distinct, mismatched finish.
